size_signals.signal: Business description: 'family owned and operated... We grow in three different locations in Middlesex and Monmouth Counties. We supply plant material to garden centers, re-wholesalers, and landscapers. We propagate most of our own plant material.'
Listed with address, phone and Mon-Fri 8am-4pm hours in the Middlesex County farm-products plan
Appears on the NJ Dept. of Agriculture certified nurseries and dealers directory

listing.reviews: none yet ('just getting started with online reviews')

top_issues: No website at all - no plant availability list, no delivery area, no trade account info
Hours shown as 'unknown' on the leading directory page
No quote, order or availability request path except a phone call

agent_readiness.notes: Nothing owned to check robots.txt or JSON-LD against; no route to a claimed profile could be confirmed. Services exist only as one sentence of copy on an aggregator page - no availability, pricing or delivery text a model could quote. Booking/ordering is phone-only.

operations_signals.signal: B2B grower with three sites and no online availability list - every trade buyer request (species, quantity, delivery week) is handled by phone or email manually (inference)
Hours listed as Mon-Fri 8am-4pm only, so inquiries outside that window are lost without an answering/quote system

top_opportunities.evidence: Three-location wholesale grower whose entire sales cycle is bespoke quotes, currently with no web intake at all

scores.reasons: Zero online presence for a three-location wholesale grower is a total gap; trade revenue across three sites suggests real budget, and a starter site plus a quote form is quick. Evidence is state and aggregator listings, not the owner's own materials.

customers: Local dog and cat owners, especially doodle, spaniel and double-coat owners paying $105-$220 per groom

Zero LocalBusiness/Service JSON-LD (no ld+json scripts found), so hours and services are not machine-answerable

top_opportunities.opportunity: Publish hours, service-area and LocalBusiness/Service JSON-LD plus per-service pages so an assistant can answer 'open now?', 'what does a doodle groom cost?', 'where are you?' without a call
